stories.h: INEC says its staff in about 10 states uploaded AI photos to voters' register
stories.p: INEC says it has identified its own officials in about 10 states who uploaded AI-generated photographs to the voters' register. The images have been removed and the commission says the staff involved will face disciplinary action.
body: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) says it has identified officials in about 10 states who uploaded photographs generated by artificial intelligence to Nigeria's voters' register.
## What INEC said

Speaking on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, at a webinar on AI, misinformation and the 2027 elections, INEC National Commissioner Mohammed Haruna, who chairs the commission's Information and Voter Education Committee, said a large number of AI-generated pictures had been posted onto the register and had since been taken down. He said the commission had the names of the staff involved across about 10 states and would take disciplinary action against them.
## Limits on what INEC can do

Haruna said it could be difficult for the commission to stop members of the public from digitally altering their own photographs before submitting them, but that INEC could act directly where its own staff were responsible.
## Background

The issue of AI-generated images on the register had already drawn public attention, raising concerns about the accuracy of the voter roll ahead of the general elections. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: INEC has named staff in about 10 states.
The AI photos have been removed.
Disciplinary action is planned.

stories.h: First Lady Remi Tinubu receives U-17 World Cup champions Flamingos at the Villa
stories.p: First Lady Oluremi Tinubu, standing in for President Tinubu, received the Flamingos at the Presidential Villa in Abuja after their historic FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup win, the first by an African team.
body: The Flamingos, Nigeria's under-17 women's football team, have been welcomed at the Presidential Villa in Abuja after winning the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup.
## The reception

First Lady Oluremi Tinubu received the players and officials on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, on behalf of President Bola Tinubu, in what was described as a celebratory homecoming visit and the federal government's formal recognition of the team's achievement.
## The win

The Flamingos beat Japan 2–1 in the final in Morocco on Saturday, 7 November, with goals from Awawu Bashiru and Oluebube Umejiaku, becoming the first African side to win the tournament. After losing their opening game to Poland, they won five matches in a row, including victories over defending champions North Korea, Mexico, Venezuela and Brazil. The win means Nigeria has now won the FIFA U-17 World Cup in both the men's and women's competitions.
## Rewards
The Senate has pledged ₦100 million to the team. The players had earlier received $50,000 in cash.
more: Remi Tinubu received the team for the President.
The Flamingos beat Japan 2–1 in the final.
The Senate has pledged ₦100 million.

stories.h: Uzodimma insists he will keep Imo West Senate ticket despite court ruling
stories.p: Imo governor Hope Uzodimma says he will not give up the APC ticket for Imo West senatorial district, despite a Federal High Court ruling that named his predecessor Rochas Okorocha as the party's candidate.
body: Imo State governor Hope Uzodimma has vowed to continue his bid for the Imo West Senate seat, despite a court judgment that removed him as the All Progressives Congress (APC) candidate.
## What he said

Speaking after Mass at the Government House chapel in Owerri, reported on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, Uzodimma dismissed suggestions that he would surrender the ticket, telling supporters that anyone who says someone else will take it from him is lying. He urged residents to campaign for APC candidates in state and federal races, naming the party's candidates for the Okigwe and Owerri zones, and continued to present himself as the party's candidate for Orlu, the Imo West zone.
## The court ruling

A Federal High Court recently ruled that former governor Rochas Okorocha, not Uzodimma, is the APC's rightful candidate for Imo West. Okorocha, who represented the district in the Senate from 2019 to 2023, was congratulated on the ruling by former APC chairman Abdullahi Ganduje.
## Background

Uzodimma, who is serving his second term as governor and cannot run again, is a key ally of President Bola Tinubu in the South-East. FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has denied having any role in the judgment.
more: Uzodimma says he will keep the ticket.
A court named Okorocha as the APC candidate.
Uzodimma is in his second and final term.

stories.h: Owerri event centre that hosted Obi town hall marked by Imo government
stories.p: An event centre in Owerri that hosted a Nigeria Democratic Congress town hall meeting with Peter Obi has reportedly been marked by the Imo State government, which demanded its title documents within 48 hours. Some Nigerians link the move to the event; others say the owners should simply produce the papers.
body: An event centre in Owerri, Imo State, has reportedly been marked by the state government days after hosting a town hall meeting of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC).
## What happened

Photos shared online on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, show a message sprayed in red paint on the property, attributed to the Imo State government, asking the owners to show their title document and ground rent receipts within 48 hours. The venue, on Port Harcourt Road in New Owerri, hosted a town hall meeting with Peter Obi, the NDC presidential candidate, and his allies on 31 October.
## How people reacted

Some social media users questioned whether the venue was being punished for hosting an opposition event, while others said the owners should simply present the requested documents and urged critics not to politicise the matter. The state government had not publicly explained the reason for the notice at the time of writing.
## Background
Imo is governed by Hope Uzodimma of the All Progressives Congress (APC), a strong supporter of President Bola Tinubu's re-election. The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: The notice asks for title documents within 48 hours.
The venue hosted an Obi town hall on 31 October.
Reactions online are divided.

stories.h: Olamide announces YBNL reunion concert with Adekunle Gold, Fireboy and Lil Kesh
stories.p: Olamide is bringing past and present YBNL stars, including Adekunle Gold, Fireboy DML, Lil Kesh, Young Jonn and Pheelz, together for a reunion show in Lagos on 18 December.
body: Rapper and record label boss Olamide has announced a reunion concert featuring some of the biggest names to come through his label, YBNL.
## The line-up

In an Instagram video on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, Olamide said the show will take place in Lagos on 18 December as part of a December festival. The line-up includes Adekunle Gold, Lil Kesh, Fireboy DML and Young Jonn, as well as producer Pheelz and DJ Enimoney.
## Why it matters

The artists represent different eras of the label. Adekunle Gold and Lil Kesh rose to fame in YBNL's early years, while Fireboy DML and Young Jonn became key names later on. Pheelz produced many of the label's hits and helped shape its sound.
## Background

Olamide founded YBNL in 2012 and has helped launch several successful careers. He recently announced a headline show at London's 20,000-capacity O2 Arena on 25 March 2027, and released a new single in October.
more: The show is on 18 December in Lagos.
Adekunle Gold, Fireboy and Lil Kesh are on the bill.
Olamide also plans an O2 Arena show in March.

stories.h: Pochettino reportedly close to deal to become Manchester United coach
stories.p: Manchester United are reportedly close to agreeing a deal with Mauricio Pochettino to become their next head coach if they decide to sack Michael Carrick.
body: Manchester United are reportedly close to agreeing terms with Mauricio Pochettino to take charge of the club.
## What is reported

According to reports on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the deal would only go ahead if United decide to sack their current head coach, Michael Carrick. No decision has been publicly announced, and the club has not commented.
## Who is Pochettino
The Argentine has previously managed Tottenham Hotspur, Paris Saint-Germain and Chelsea, and was appointed head coach of the United States men's national team in September 2024.
## Background

Carrick has come under growing pressure after a run of poor results, and senior figures at the club are reported to have met to discuss his future. Several candidates have been linked with the job in recent days.
more: The move depends on United sacking Carrick.
Pochettino has managed Spurs, PSG and Chelsea.

stories.h: Salvadoran troops reportedly launch deadly operation against Haitian gang, leaving 20 dead
stories.p: At least 20 people have reportedly been killed in an operation involving troops from El Salvador against suspected gang members in Haiti, where armed groups have taken control of large areas and forced thousands from their homes.
body: At least 20 people have reportedly been killed in an operation involving Salvadoran troops targeting suspected gang members in Haiti.
## A country held hostage

The reported incident comes as Haiti continues to struggle with widespread gang violence, kidnappings and insecurity, particularly in areas where armed groups have taken control of communities and forced thousands of residents to flee.
For years, ordinary Haitians have lived under the constant threat of armed gangs, with many families unable to go about their daily lives without fear.
## Foreign forces on the ground
Soldiers from El Salvador have been in Haiti since early 2025 as part of an internationally backed mission to help the Haitian police fight the gangs, alongside forces from other countries.
The reported operation has raised fresh questions about the growing role of foreign security forces in efforts to restore order in the troubled Caribbean nation.
## What we don't know
The circumstances of the reported deaths, including the identities of those killed and the exact role played by the Salvadoran troops, have not been independently confirmed.
## Over to you
Can foreign military intervention finally help Haiti regain control from armed gangs, or will it only lead to more bloodshed?
more: At least 20 people were reportedly killed.
Salvadoran troops are part of a mission to fight Haiti's gangs.
The details have not been independently confirmed.

stories.h: Tinubu launches ₦52,500 minimum monthly pension for 173,209 retirees
stories.p: President Tinubu has activated a guaranteed minimum pension of ₦52,500 a month for 173,209 retirees under the Contributory Pension Scheme, a provision that has been in law since 2004 but was never enforced. He also launched free basic healthcare for low-income pensioners.
body: Retirees under Nigeria's Contributory Pension Scheme will now receive at least ₦52,500 a month, after President Bola Tinubu activated a minimum pension guarantee in Abuja.
## What was announced

At the Presidential Pension Security Initiatives ceremony at the State House on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the President, represented by Senate President Godswill Akpabio, declared the guarantee active for 173,209 qualifying retirees. He described it as a floor beneath Nigerian retirees and urged future governments to raise it but never remove it. The Director-General of the National Pension Commission (PenCom), Omolola Oloworaran, confirmed the figure and said more than 65 per cent of private-sector retirees currently earn less than the new minimum.
## Who benefits

According to PenCom, 54 per cent of the qualifying retirees come from the private sector, 34 per cent from federal service and 12 per cent from state employment. More than ₦400bn in the Pension Protection Fund will finance the guarantee.
## Healthcare and arrears

The President also launched PenCare, a healthcare plan that will give low-income pensioners free access to essential health services, with access cards to be distributed in the coming months. He said the government had issued a ₦758bn bond to clear pension arrears and approved a ₦32,000 monthly adjustment for affected federal pensioners.
## Background
The minimum pension was first written into the Pension Reform Act of 2004 and kept in the 2014 law, but no government had put it into effect until now.
more: 173,209 retirees qualify for the ₦52,500 minimum.
Free healthcare for low-income pensioners was also launched.
A ₦758bn bond will clear pension arrears.

stories.h: Police open probe after video shows officers escorting Blord
stories.p: The Nigeria Police Force says it has opened an investigation after a video showed police officers escorting businessman and influencer Blord, describing the arrangement as unlawful. Some social media users have defended him.
body: The Nigeria Police Force has launched an investigation into officers seen in a video providing an escort for businessman and social media personality Linus Williams, popularly known as Blord.
## What the police said

In a post on X on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the Force Public Relations Officer described the situation as unlawful and illegal, added the hashtag #NoToImpunity, and confirmed that a probe had begun. The statement did not make clear exactly which part of the incident is being investigated.
## Background

The video drew attention after social media users pointed out that Blord had recently been seen in caps associated with Rabiu Kwankwaso, running mate to Peter Obi, the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), fuelling speculation about his political leanings. Blord was recently released from detention and publicly thanked activist Omoyele Sowore, now a presidential candidate himself, for his intervention. In late 2025, President Bola Tinubu ordered the withdrawal of police officers attached to VIPs.
## How people reacted
The police announcement drew strong reactions online, with some users defending Blord. Blord had not publicly responded at the time of writing.
more: Police called the escort arrangement unlawful.
An investigation has begun.
Blord has not yet responded.

stories.h: Dangote refinery reportedly cuts petrol price to ₦1,250 and drops fixed pricing
stories.p: Dangote Petroleum Refinery has reportedly cut its petrol loading price to ₦1,250 per litre, down ₦50, after returning to a pricing system linked to international gasoline prices. That means pump prices could now rise or fall with global markets.
body: Dangote Petroleum Refinery has reportedly reduced its petrol loading price to ₦1,250 per litre and changed how it sets prices.
## What changed

According to industry sources cited in reports on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the new arrangement took effect on Saturday, 7 November. The refinery is said to have abandoned its fixed gantry price of ₦1,300 per litre and returned to pricing petrol against an international gasoline benchmark. The new price is about ₦50, or roughly 3.85 per cent, lower.
## What it means

Under the benchmark-linked system, the refinery's petrol prices can move up or down with global gasoline prices, rather than staying fixed. Diesel is reportedly still sold at a fixed gantry price. The refinery is also said to have restructured the group of marketers that distribute its products.
## Background

The change comes amid growing competition in Nigeria's fuel market between the refinery, importers and depot owners, with prices shifting frequently in recent weeks. How much of the cut reaches motorists at filling stations will depend on marketers.
more: The loading price is reportedly ₦1,250 per litre.
Prices will now track global gasoline prices.
Diesel pricing is said to be unchanged.

stories.h: Adamawa governor Fintiri denies threatening to detain 'Bamayi' chanters
stories.p: Adamawa governor Ahmadu Fintiri's media team says a report claiming he threatened to detain anyone who shouts 'Bamayi' until after the 2027 elections is false, and has demanded a retraction from the online blog that published it.
body: The media office of Adamawa State governor Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri has rejected a report that the governor threatened to detain people who shout the slogan 'Bamayi'.
## The claim

A report circulating on social media alleged that Fintiri had said anyone chanting 'Bamayi', a Hausa political slogan, would be detained until after the 2027 general elections. In a statement reported on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the governor's aide on electronic media said Fintiri never made such a statement, publicly or privately, and described the report as fabricated and a deliberate misrepresentation of his position.
## Demand for retraction

The statement named a Hausa-language online blog based in Jigawa State as the source and asked it to withdraw the report and apologise, or produce evidence to support it. It warned that legal action could follow if it did neither. The governor's team said the report was designed to stoke political tension and damage his reputation ahead of the elections.
## Background

Fintiri has governed Adamawa since 2019 and is in his second term. Political tension has been rising across the country ahead of the 2027 general elections, with false reports and misinformation becoming a growing concern for parties and candidates on all sides.
more: Fintiri's team says the report is false.
It demanded a retraction and an apology.
Legal action has been threatened.

stories.h: BBNaija's Faith builds filter game for Funke Akindele's new film The Four
stories.p: Reality star Dr Faith Adewale has created a Snapchat filter game inspired by Funke Akindele's upcoming film The Four, complete with a ticket-booking button. Funke Akindele reacted warmly to the fan-made promotion.
body: Big Brother Naija star Dr Faith Adewale has won praise online after creating a game to promote Funke Akindele's upcoming film, The Four.
## The game

In a video shared on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, Faith showed how the Snapchat filter works. Players are paired with three of their real friends and must complete quick physical challenges, such as tapping the screen rapidly or raising their eyebrows, to 'rescue' each one. When all three are saved, the group of four is reunited, echoing the theme of the film. Faith set a time of 15.4 seconds and challenged her followers to beat it. The filter also includes a button that links to a cinema website where users can buy tickets.
## Funke reacts
Funke Akindele, who directs and stars in the film, spotted the post and responded with delight, and the cinema chain also celebrated the idea online.
## Background

The Four is due in Nigerian cinemas on 11 December 2026, in time for the festive season. Funke Akindele is one of Nollywood's most commercially successful filmmakers, with several of her previous December releases breaking box office records.
more: Faith built a Snapchat filter game for The Four.
Funke Akindele praised the idea.
The film opens on 11 December 2026.

stories.h: Ebola: 28 contacts still under watch in Nigeria, 34 cleared, says NCDC
stories.p: The NCDC says 28 people linked to Nigeria's single imported case of Bundibugyo virus disease, a type of Ebola, remain under surveillance, while 34 others have been cleared after 21 days of monitoring. No further cases have been confirmed.
body: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) says 28 people linked to the country's imported Ebola case are still being monitored.
## The update

In its national health security update released on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, NCDC Director-General Dr Jide Idris said 34 other contacts had been discharged after completing the mandatory 21-day monitoring period. As of 9 November, Nigeria had confirmed only one imported case of Bundibugyo virus disease, a species of Ebola, with no further confirmed cases.
## The response

Idris said the response involves the Federal Ministry of Health, the FCT Administration, state authorities and development partners, with contact tracing, investigation of reported cases, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, safe patient care and stronger screening at entry points.
## Background

Ebola is a severe and often deadly viral disease spread through contact with the body fluids of infected people. The 21-day monitoring period reflects the maximum incubation time of the virus. The case in Nigeria is linked to an outbreak in Central Africa; the United States has just barred travellers who have been in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the past 21 days. Nigeria contained an Ebola outbreak in 2014.
## Advice

Health authorities urge anyone with symptoms such as fever, weakness, vomiting or unexplained bleeding, especially after travel or contact with a suspected case, to report to a health facility immediately.
more: 28 contacts remain under surveillance.
34 have been cleared after 21 days.

stories.h: US bars travellers who have been in DR Congo in the last 21 days over Ebola
stories.p: The US CDC has temporarily barred anyone who has been in the Democratic Republic of Congo within the past 21 days, including US citizens and transit passengers, from boarding flights to the United States because of Ebola.
body: The United States has imposed a temporary travel restriction on people who have recently been in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) because of Ebola.
## The rule

The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) said anyone who has been in the DRC in the past 21 days may not board a flight to the United States, according to reports on Wednesday, 11 November 2026. The rule applies to American citizens as well as foreigners, and covers passengers whose aircraft stopped at a DRC airport even if they did not leave the plane. Affected travellers must wait until 21 days have passed since they left the DRC. The US Embassy in Kinshasa announced the measure on social media.
## Why 21 days
The period matches the maximum incubation time of the Ebola virus.
## Background

The restriction comes amid an Ebola outbreak in Central Africa. Nigeria is currently monitoring contacts of one imported case of Bundibugyo virus disease, a species of Ebola, and says no further cases have been confirmed.
more: The ban covers anyone in the DRC in the last 21 days.
It includes US citizens and transit passengers.
The measure is temporary.

stories.h: Donald Duke says he will step down if opposition agrees on single candidate
stories.p: PRP presidential candidate Donald Duke says he is willing to step aside for a stronger opposition candidate, such as Atiku Abubakar or Peter Obi, if opposition parties agree through a credible process on who should face President Tinubu.
body: Donald Duke, the presidential candidate of the Peoples Redemption Party (PRP), says he is ready to step aside for a stronger opposition candidate in the 2027 election.
## What he said

Speaking in Abuja on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, at the unveiling of his running mate, Malam Sule Mohammed, and the launch of the PRP's manifesto, the former Cross River governor said he would respect any democratic decision by opposition parties to rally behind one candidate to challenge President Bola Tinubu, whether Atiku Abubakar of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) or Peter Obi of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), as long as the choice came through a credible collective process. He said a genuine coalition could not simply gather around a name, and needed a shared agenda.
## Background

Duke governed Cross River State from 1999 to 2007 and is known for developing the Obudu Ranch Resort and the Tinapa project. He was a presidential candidate in 2023. There are 18 presidential candidates for the 16 January 2027 election. Talks about a single opposition candidate have repeatedly stalled, with Atiku and Obi both insisting on running.
more: Duke is the PRP presidential candidate.
He named Atiku and Obi as possible options.
He wants a credible collective process.

stories.h: Sule Lamido denies Shettima's claim that he backs the APC
stories.p: Former Jigawa governor Sule Lamido has rejected Vice-President Kashim Shettima's claim that he is among Jigawa leaders supporting the APC, asking why he would join the party in 2026 when he did not in 2014.
body: Former Jigawa State governor Sule Lamido has denied claims by Vice-President Kashim Shettima that he supports the All Progressives Congress (APC).
## What happened

In a video shared online, Shettima said prominent politicians in Jigawa, including Lamido, were backing the APC. Responding in Hausa in the comments under a Facebook post of the video, reported on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, Lamido asked why he would be with the APC in 2026 when he was not with the party in 2014, and described the claim as a lie.
## Background

Lamido, a former foreign affairs minister, governed Jigawa from 2007 to 2015 as a member of the PDP and has remained a prominent opposition figure. Shettima's comments came around President Bola Tinubu's visit to Jigawa on Tuesday, when the President held a campaign rally and inaugurated projects in Dutse. Jigawa is governed by the APC's Umar Namadi.
more: Shettima said Lamido backs the APC.

stories.h: Edo governor Okpebholo vows to sign death warrants for convicted kidnappers, 'even my father'
stories.p: Edo governor Monday Okpebholo says he will sign the death warrants of anyone convicted of kidnapping under the state's law, even if it were his own father, as his government moves to enforce the death penalty for the crime.
body: Edo State governor Monday Okpebholo says he will approve the execution of convicted kidnappers, regardless of who they are.
## What he said

In a video shared on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, the governor said he would sign death warrants for anyone found guilty of kidnapping, even if it were his own father or a close relative. He said the state needed to remove criminal elements from society, arguing that kidnappers were the ones killing people.
## The law

Edo State has a law that prescribes the death penalty for kidnapping, and the governor's administration says it is moving to enforce it. Under Nigerian law, state governors must sign death warrants before executions can take place.
## Background
Executions in Nigeria are rare because governors have generally been reluctant to sign death warrants, and human rights groups oppose the death penalty.
more: Okpebholo says he will sign death warrants.

stories.h: Seun Kuti questions Peter Obi's education record in resurfaced interview
stories.p: In a resurfaced interview clip, musician Seun Kuti alleges that Peter Obi's policies as Anambra governor kept poor children out of good public schools, and says high exam results mean little if access is limited. Obi's supporters dispute the claim.
body: Afrobeat musician and activist Seun Kuti has sparked debate after a resurfaced interview clip in which he criticises Peter Obi's education record as Anambra governor.
## What he said

In the clip, reported on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, Kuti challenged what he called a selective retelling of history about governors praised for their track records. He alleged that Obi's policies in Anambra pushed children of low-income families out of public schools, and argued that the state's strong results in external exams such as WAEC meant little if access to quality education depended on families' economic status.
## Background

Obi, now the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), governed Anambra from 2006 to 2014. His supporters often point to the state's improved exam results during his time in office. Kuti, the youngest son of Afrobeat legend Fela Anikulapo-Kuti, has been a critic of several major politicians. Obi's campaign had not responded to the clip at the time of writing.
more: Kuti alleges poor children lost out under Obi.

Obi's supporters dispute the claim.

stories.h: Bobrisky hits back at TBoss over criticism of men in feminine fashion
stories.p: Bobrisky has responded to reality star TBoss, who criticised Nigerian men adopting feminine dressing styles at Lagos fashion events, saying nobody has the right to dictate how adults dress.
body: Socialite Bobrisky has publicly responded to Big Brother Naija alumna TBoss over her comments about men who dress in feminine styles.
## How it started

TBoss, whose real name is Tokunbo Idowu, had expressed disapproval of what she described as a growing trend of Nigerian men adopting feminine styles, following outfits seen at GTCO Fashion Week in Lagos, saying 'we're slowly losing our men'. Her remarks sparked debate, with influencer Izzy Ogbeide and model Onyx Godwin among those who disagreed.
## Bobrisky's response

In a series of Instagram posts on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, Bobrisky said they held TBoss in some regard but found her comments out of line, insisting that nobody has the right to tell another adult how to dress or express themselves. Bobrisky drew a distinction between sharing a personal opinion and trying to impose it on others.
## Background

Bobrisky now lives abroad. Content creator Enioluwa also defended the men's outfits at the fashion week, saying it was a fashion show and nobody was losing anything. TBoss had not responded at the time of writing.
more: TBoss criticised men's feminine fashion.
Bobrisky said nobody should dictate how adults dress.

stories.h: INEC asks court to cancel subpoena for Tinubu's 1999 and 2023 election records
stories.p: INEC has asked the Federal High Court in Abuja to set aside a subpoena ordering its chairman to appear and produce President Tinubu's 1999 and 2023 nomination documents in the trial of activist Omoyele Sowore.
body: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has asked the Federal High Court in Abuja to set aside a subpoena requiring its chairman to produce President Bola Tinubu's election documents.
## The application

INEC's lawyer, Alex Izinyon, a Senior Advocate of Nigeria, filed the motion on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, the day before INEC chairman Professor Joash Amupitan was due to appear as a defence witness in the criminal trial of activist Omoyele Sowore. The subpoena, issued by Justice Mohammed Umar, had directed the INEC chairman to produce Tinubu's nomination forms from the 1999 Lagos governorship election, including an affidavit relating to lost certificates, and from the 2023 presidential election.
## The case

Sowore is being prosecuted by the State Security Service over social media posts in which he described the President as a criminal. His defence team asked the court to call the INEC chairman and Joe Igbokwe, a former APC publicity secretary in Lagos, as witnesses.
## Background

Questions about the President's academic records have been raised by critics for years and were the subject of legal challenges after the 2023 election, which the Supreme Court dismissed. The President and his supporters have consistently rejected claims of wrongdoing.
more: INEC wants the subpoena set aside.

stories.h: Emergency number 112 fails to connect live on TV after APC official says it works
stories.p: A member of the APC presidential campaign council, Alwan Hassan, dared a TV anchor to call the national emergency number 112 live on air to prove it works, but the call failed to connect, sparking reactions online.
body: A live television debate took an awkward turn on Tuesday night, 10 November 2026, when Nigeria's national emergency number failed to connect after a ruling party official insisted it worked.
## What happened

Speaking on a Channels Television programme to highlight the government's achievements, Alwan Hassan, a member of the APC presidential campaign council, said the 112 emergency response system had been upgraded and worked reliably nationwide. To prove his point, he dared the anchor, Seun Okinbaloye, to call the number live on air. The anchor accepted, dialled 112 on his phone, but the call did not go through.
## Background

The 112 toll-free number is meant to connect people to police, fire, ambulance and other emergency services across Nigeria. Emergency response became a talking point last week when actor Kunle Afod complained about the response to a crash on the Lagos–Ibadan Expressway.
more: Hassan said 112 works nationwide.

stories.h: Suspended Reform UK councillor convicted over post saying Nigerians should be 'melted down'
stories.p: Glenn Gibbins, a suspended Reform UK councillor, has been found guilty of sending a malicious communication after a Facebook post saying Nigerians should be melted down and used to fill potholes.
body: A suspended Reform UK councillor in England has been convicted over a social media post about Nigerians.
## The case

Glenn Gibbins, 66, was found guilty at South Tyneside Magistrates' Court of sending a malicious communication, according to reports on Tuesday, 10 November 2026. In a Facebook post, he had complained about the number of Nigerians in the town and said they should be melted down and used to fill potholes. He told the court on Monday that the post was 'naughty' but that he did not mean it literally. The prosecutor said the comment conjured up despicable images and implied that Nigerians were less than human.
## How it came to light

The post was found by the anti-racism group Hope Not Hate when it reviewed Gibbins's social media after he was announced as a Reform UK candidate for Sunderland City Council. He was later suspended by the party.
## Background
Reform UK is led by Nigel Farage. Nigerians make up one of the largest African communities in the UK.

stories.h: Abia APC chairman urges Igbo voters to back Tinubu, says 2023 approach was an error
stories.p: Abia APC chairman Chijioke Chukwu says it is wrong to believe the Igbo are not supporting President Tinubu, and urged them not to repeat what he called the political error of 2023, when many voted for Peter Obi.
body: The chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in Abia State, Chijioke Chukwu, has called on Igbo people to rally behind President Bola Tinubu in 2027.
## What he said

In a Facebook post on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, Chukwu said it was wrong to believe that the Igbo were not supporting Tinubu and were backing Peter Obi, the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC). He argued that many Igbo voters acted out of political naivety in 2023 by believing that their numbers alone could produce a president of Igbo origin without building alliances with other regions, and warned against repeating that approach.
## Background

The debate over how the Igbo should vote in 2027 has intensified this week. Senator Victor Umeh of the NDC said any Igbo person who works against Obi is an enemy of the Igbo, a remark criticised by actor Yul Edochie. Several South-East governors have declared support for Tinubu, including Ebonyi's Francis Nwifuru, who promised him 80 per cent of the state's votes, while Abia's governor, Alex Otti, was elected on the Labour Party platform.
## What happens next
The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: Chukwu says the Igbo do back Tinubu.
He called the 2023 approach naive.
The debate follows Senator Umeh's remarks.

stories.h: Fact check: Obasanjo did not ask Nigerians to reject Tinubu's second term
stories.p: A viral Facebook post claiming Olusegun Obasanjo urged Nigerians to reject President Tinubu's re-election is misleading, a fact-check found. Obasanjo criticised the government's borrowing but did not call for Tinubu to be voted out.
body: A viral social media post claiming that former President Olusegun Obasanjo called on Nigerians to reject President Bola Tinubu's second-term bid has been found to be misleading.
## The claim

The post, shared by a Facebook page, had gathered thousands of likes and hundreds of shares by Tuesday, 10 November 2026. It circulated as attention grew on the government's supplementary borrowing plan of about $20.5 billion and €1 billion, sent to the National Assembly in October to fund infrastructure, agriculture, health, education, security and other areas.
## What Obasanjo actually said

According to the fact-check, Obasanjo's remarks were a response to Tinubu's comment that 'borrowing is not leprosy', which Obasanjo described as nonsense, warning that excessive debt could destroy generations. Reports of his comments by several media organisations show he did not ask Nigerians to reject the President or vote against his re-election. His criticism was aimed at the government's approach to borrowing.
## Background

Borrowing has become a major campaign issue. The Presidency has rejected claims that it has added ₦120 trillion to the national debt, while opposition candidates have criticised new loan requests, including a planned $500 million World Bank facility.
more: Obasanjo criticised borrowing, not Tinubu's re-election.
The viral post was misleading.
Borrowing is a key campaign issue.

stories.h: Davido gifts aide Israel DMW a new 2026 Toyota Prado
stories.p: Davido has given his longtime aide and logistics manager, Israel DMW, a brand-new 2026 Toyota Prado. Israel showed off the SUV online, saying he has never regretted following the singer.
body: Singer Davido has given his longtime aide, Israel DMW, a new 2026 Toyota Prado.
## What happened

Israel, the singer's logistics manager, showed off the SUV in a video on Instagram, reported on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, thanking Davido for the gift. He said he had never regretted his decision to follow and work with the singer.
## Background

Israel DMW has worked with Davido for many years and is one of the most visible members of his team. Last week, he defended Davido against claims by social media activist VeryDarkMan, saying the singer had no hand in VDM's arrest or Naira Marley's troubles. Davido, who recently travelled to Tanzania with his wife Chioma, has given gifts to members of his team before.

stories.h: Paul McCartney becomes a billionaire, third-richest musician in the world
stories.p: Former Beatle Paul McCartney is now worth about $1.4 billion, according to Forbes, making him the world's third-richest musician after Jay-Z and Taylor Swift.
body: Paul McCartney has officially become a billionaire.
## The figures

Forbes now values the former Beatles member's fortune at about $1.4 billion, according to reports on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, making him the third-richest musician in the world. Only rapper and businessman Jay-Z, at about $2.8 billion, and Taylor Swift, at about $2 billion, are ranked higher.
## How he made it

Forbes attributes his wealth to six decades of songwriting, shrewd acquisitions of music rights and personal assets. Despite their global fame in the 1960s, The Beatles earned relatively little from their early record contracts, something McCartney has spoken about in the past.
## Background
McCartney co-wrote many of The Beatles' most famous songs with John Lennon and went on to a hugely successful solo career and with the band Wings.
more: McCartney is worth about $1.4 billion.
He is the third-richest musician.
Jay-Z and Taylor Swift are ahead of him.

stories.h: Harry Kane becomes first Ballon d'Or winner left out of FIFPRO World XI
stories.p: Bayern Munich striker Harry Kane, who won the 2026 Ballon d'Or after scoring 73 goals in 65 games, has been left out of the FIFPRO Men's World XI, the first time a reigning winner has missed out since 2005.
body: Harry Kane has become the first Ballon d'Or winner to be left out of the FIFPRO Men's World XI in the same year.
## What happened

The team, voted for by professional players around the world and announced on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, did not include the Bayern Munich and England striker, who won the 2026 Ballon d'Or after scoring 73 goals in 65 appearances for club and country. Erling Haaland and Kylian Mbappé were among the forwards chosen ahead of him.
## A first
It is the first time since the FIFPRO World XI was introduced in 2005 that the reigning Ballon d'Or winner has failed to make the team.
## Background

The Ballon d'Or is voted for by journalists, while the FIFPRO World XI is chosen by fellow players, and the two awards do not always agree. Kane joined Bayern Munich from Tottenham Hotspur in 2023 and has been one of the most prolific goalscorers in Europe since.
more: Kane scored 73 goals in 65 games.
He won the 2026 Ballon d'Or.
He is the first winner omitted from the FIFPRO XI.

stories.h: Senate sets aside ₦100 million reward for World Cup-winning Flamingos
stories.p: Senate President Godswill Akpabio has announced a ₦100 million reward for the Flamingos after their FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup win, following a motion by Senator Abdul Ningi, who said the team had received too little recognition.
body: The Senate has set aside ₦100 million for the Flamingos, Nigeria's under-17 women's football team, after their victory at the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup.
## What happened

Senate President Godswill Akpabio announced the reward during plenary on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, as the chamber considered a congratulatory motion moved by Senator Abdul Ningi of the ADC, who represents Bauchi Central. Ningi described the team's win as historic, saying the young players had achieved what many senior national teams had not, despite going into the tournament with little public attention. He said the players deserved far more publicity and a proper reception on their return.
## Background

The Flamingos beat Japan 2-1 in the final in Rabat, Morocco, on 7 November to become the first African team to win the tournament, and Nigeria's first FIFA world champions in women's football at any level. FIFA does not pay prize money for the competition, but a sponsor of the National Sports Commission gave the team $50,000 in Rabat. NDC candidate Peter Obi said NFF officials stopped him from greeting the team at Abuja airport, a claim the Presidency said politicised the national teams.
more: The Senate approved ₦100 million for the Flamingos.
Senator Ningi said the team deserved more recognition.
FIFA pays no prize money for the tournament.

stories.h: Amaechi says Nigerians now miss Buhari because life was better under him
stories.p: ADC vice-presidential candidate Rotimi Amaechi says Nigerians miss former President Buhari, urging them to compare the exchange rate and fuel prices under Buhari with today. The APC says the reforms were needed to save the economy.
body: Rotimi Amaechi, the vice-presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), says Nigerians miss former President Muhammadu Buhari because life was better under his government.
## What he said

Speaking on a television programme on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, Amaechi recalled Buhari's prediction that people would one day call him back, and said Nigerians were now saying they miss him. He urged people to compare their lives under Buhari with their circumstances today, pointing to the exchange rate, fuel prices and what he described as corruption.
## Background

Amaechi served as Buhari's Minister of Transportation and directed his 2015 campaign, before losing the APC presidential ticket to Bola Tinubu in 2022. He said last week that Buhari had promised in writing to back him at that primary. Buhari died in 2025. The naira traded at about ₦461 to the dollar when Tinubu took office in May 2023 and petrol was subsidised; both changed sharply after the President removed the subsidy and unified the exchange rate. Tinubu says those reforms saved Nigeria from economic collapse and that the naira has since recovered some value.
## What happens next
The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: Amaechi says Nigerians miss Buhari.
He cited the exchange rate and fuel prices.
Tinubu says his reforms saved the economy.

stories.h: Mele Kyari denies ₦210 trillion went missing at NNPC under his watch
stories.p: Former NNPC boss Mele Kyari has told a Senate committee that no money was lost under his leadership, saying the disputed ₦210 trillion in the company's accounts came from a misreading of its financial records.
body: Former Group Managing Director of the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL), Mele Kyari, has denied that ₦210 trillion went unaccounted for while he led the company.
## What happened

Kyari appeared before the Senate Committee on Public Accounts, which is examining queries raised by the Auditor-General of the Federation over NNPCL's audited financial statements for 2017 to 2023, according to reports on Tuesday, 10 November 2026. The disputed figure is made up of ₦103 trillion recorded as accrued expenses and ₦107 trillion listed as sundry receivables. Kyari told the committee that no money was lost under his watch and that the figures arose from a misreading of the company's records.
## The committee's position
The committee began examining the figures in June 2025 and has repeatedly rejected the company's explanations, insisting that NNPCL properly account for the entries.
## Background
Kyari led NNPC from 2019 until 2025, overseeing its conversion into a limited liability company under the Petroleum Industry Act.
more: Kyari says no money was lost under his watch.
The disputed sum is about ₦210 trillion.
The Senate committee has rejected earlier explanations.

stories.h: Gunmen kill Miyetti Allah chairman in Takum, Taraba State
stories.p: Gunmen have reportedly killed Alhaji Ibrahim Dio, chairman of the Miyetti Allah Cattle Breeders Association in Takum LGA of Taraba State, at his home shortly after he returned from the cattle market.
body: Gunmen have reportedly killed the chairman of the Miyetti Allah Cattle Breeders Association (MACBAN) in Takum Local Government Area of Taraba State.
## What happened

According to reports, Alhaji Ibrahim Dio was attacked at his home in the Abuja Quarters area of Takum on the evening of Sunday, 8 November 2026, shortly after returning from the Takum cattle market. The gunmen reportedly arrived on a motorcycle and opened fire, killing him.
## Who he was

Residents described Dio as a dedicated community leader who worked for the welfare of Fulani residents and others in Takum, and who was said to have maintained good relations with other communities in the area.
## Background
MACBAN is the main association representing cattle breeders in Nigeria. The police had not publicly commented on the killing or any arrests at the time of writing.
more: Ibrahim Dio was killed at his home on Sunday.
He chaired MACBAN in Takum LGA.
Police have not commented.

stories.h: NERC approves ₦30bn to give free meters to remaining Band A customers
stories.p: The electricity regulator NERC has approved ₦30 billion to provide free meters to unmetered Band A customers and speed up installations for Band B customers, with all installations due by 31 May 2027.
body: The Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission (NERC) has approved ₦30 billion to provide meters to electricity customers who still do not have them.
## The plan

In a statement on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, NERC said the money, Tranche C of its Meter Acquisition Fund, took effect on 2 November. It will be used to give free meters to the remaining unmetered Band A customers, who pay the highest tariffs for at least 20 hours of supply a day, and to speed up metering for Band B customers. All installations must be completed by 31 May 2027.
## How it will work

The money will be shared among the 11 electricity distribution companies in proportion to their contributions to the fund, and meters must be spread fairly across the states in each company's area. The order is part of the third phase of the Presidential Metering Initiative and requires the companies to use transparent procurement involving eligible local meter makers, assemblers and providers.
## Background

Many Nigerian electricity customers are still billed by estimate, a long-standing source of complaints. The announcement comes after recent power cuts in Lagos, Abuja and other states that the government blamed on gas shortages, maintenance and sabotage.
more: ₦30 billion is set aside for meters.
Band A customers will get free meters.
Installations must be done by 31 May 2027.

stories.h: Imo Catholic priest apologises for singing Peter Obi campaign song in church
stories.p: Rev. Fr. Finbarr Chukwu, a Catholic priest in Imo State, has apologised after a viral video showed him singing a campaign song associated with Peter Obi during a church service, saying he joined in spontaneously.
body: A Catholic priest in Imo State has apologised after a video of him singing a campaign song associated with Peter Obi during a church service went viral.
## The apology

Rev. Fr. Finbarr Chukwu, who is attached to St. Dominic's Secondary School, Ugiri, in Isiala Mbano Local Government Area, explained himself in a letter dated 4 November 2026, addressed to the Catholic Bishop of Okigwe Diocese, Most Rev. Solomon Amatu, fellow priests, the faithful and the public. He said the incident happened during a thanksgiving service attended by a family and some people linked to a political campaign. When some of them began singing campaign songs, he said, he joined in spontaneously without considering how it would be seen.
## Regret
He said he later recognised the implications of his action and had advised those present to respect the sanctity of church functions by keeping politics out of religious events.
## Background

Obi, now the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), is a Catholic and has a strong following in the South-East. The video spread widely amid heated campaigning ahead of the 16 January 2027 election.
more: Fr. Finbarr Chukwu says he joined in spontaneously.

He urged people to keep politics out of church.

stories.h: TikToker gets suspended jail term for defamatory videos about NDA commandant
stories.p: A Kaduna High Court has given a TikToker a suspended prison sentence and a ₦500,000 fine after she pleaded guilty to posting defamatory videos about the commandant of the Nigerian Defence Academy. She was also ordered to publish an apology.
body: A TikTok content creator has been given a suspended prison sentence by a Kaduna High Court over defamatory videos about the commandant of the Nigerian Defence Academy (NDA), Major General Yemi Olatoye.
## The case

The creator faced five counts filed by the Inspector-General of Police and pleaded guilty to two of them, according to reports on Tuesday, 10 November 2026. Justice Rilwanu Aikawa sentenced her to one year in prison on each count, to run concurrently, and fined her ₦250,000 per count, ₦500,000 in total. The prison terms were suspended for three years under a plea bargain. The court also ordered her to publish a public apology in two national newspapers.
## The videos
The videos included captions blaming the general for the creator's possible death, among other claims.
## Background
The case is one of a number of prosecutions in Nigeria over social media posts about public figures.
more: The TikToker pleaded guilty to two counts.
She was fined ₦500,000 and given a suspended sentence.
She must publish an apology in two newspapers.

stories.h: "I expected VDM to drag me at my lowest, but he offered to help me get back on my feet": Blessing CEO gets emotional
stories.p: Blessing CEO says she expected VeryDarkMan to attack her during her difficult period, given their history of clashes. Instead, she says, he offered to help her rebuild her life, and she has now declared herself a member of the Ratel Movement.
body: Controversial relationship therapist Blessing CEO has expressed shock and gratitude over an unexpected gesture from social media activist VeryDarkMan (VDM).
## "I expected him to drag me"
According to her, she had expected VDM to take advantage of her difficult moment and drag her publicly, given their long history of disagreements.
Instead, she says, he offered her a helping hand and assured her that he would do whatever it takes to help her get back on her feet.
## Tears and gratitude
An emotional Blessing CEO admitted that the gesture humbled her and brought tears to her eyes. She promised to share the full story once she has regained her composure.
She also asked people to help her thank VDM, and declared that she is now officially a member of the Ratel Movement.
## A difficult season

The gesture comes during a hard period for Blessing CEO. In recent days she has publicly apologised to people she may have offended, described herself as broken and compared her journey to the prodigal son. She also announced that her relationship with businessman IVD has ended.
## Never say never
Who would have imagined Blessing CEO and VDM on the same side after everything that has happened between them? In this life, never say never.
## Over to you
Is this the start of a genuine friendship between Blessing CEO and VDM, or will old wounds come back?

stories.h: Court strikes out ₦6bn money-laundering charges against Mompha, socialite says
stories.p: Socialite Ismaila Mustapha, known as Mompha, says a court has struck out the ₦6 billion money-laundering charges filed against him by the EFCC, calling it vindication after seven years. The EFCC had not commented.
body: Socialite Ismaila Mustapha, popularly known as Mompha, says a court has struck out the money-laundering charges brought against him by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC).
## What he said

In an Instagram post on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, Mompha said the court struck out the ₦6 billion charges on the grounds that they amounted to an abuse of court process and forum shopping. He described the outcome as personal vindication after what he called years of harassment, called the prosecution a witch-hunt, praised the judge and thanked his supporters. He also mocked the anti-graft agency in the post.
## Background

Mompha's legal battle with the EFCC began in 2019, when he was arrested after returning to Nigeria. He has always denied the allegations, saying he came home to invest. The case dragged on for about seven years. The EFCC had not publicly commented on the ruling at the time of writing, and it was not immediately clear whether the commission would appeal or file fresh charges.
## What it means
Mompha says his legal ordeal is now over.
more: Mompha says the ₦6bn charges were struck out.
He says the court ruled they were an abuse of process.
The EFCC has not commented.

stories.h: James Gunn and Peter Safran to step down as DC Studios bosses
stories.p: James Gunn and Peter Safran will step down as co-CEOs of DC Studios at the end of November, four years after taking charge, following Skydance's purchase of Warner Bros. Discovery. Former Marvel executive Jeremy Latcham will take over.
body: Filmmaker James Gunn and producer Peter Safran are stepping down as co-chief executives of DC Studios.
## The announcement

The pair announced on Monday, 9 November 2026, that they will leave their roles at the end of November, four years after taking charge, following Skydance's purchase of Warner Bros. Discovery. They will be succeeded by former Marvel Studios executive Jeremy Latcham, who worked as a producer on films including 'Iron Man', 'The Avengers' and 'Guardians of the Galaxy'.
## Gunn's message

In an Instagram post, Gunn, who directed the 2025 film 'Superman', described leading DC Studios as a dream come true but said the job had been challenging, with corporate demands taking a toll on his personal life and leaving him little time with loved ones. He thanked fans and credited Safran with handling much of the corporate side of their work. Gunn will continue to work on several DC projects despite leaving the leadership role.
## Background

Gunn and Safran took over DC Studios in late 2022 with plans to build a new connected universe of DC superhero films and series. The change comes as the new owners of Warner Bros. reshape the company.
more: Gunn and Safran leave at the end of November.
Former Marvel executive Jeremy Latcham takes over.
Gunn will still work on DC projects.

stories.h: Blord spotted in Kwankwaso-linked 'Nigeria Must Be OK' cap in Kano
stories.p: Businessman Blord has sparked talk after being seen in Kano wearing a cap with a slogan associated with Rabiu Kwankwaso, months after he declared support for Omoyele Sowore's movement.
body: Businessman and social media personality Linus Williams, popularly known as Blord, has drawn attention after being seen in a cap linked to Senator Rabiu Kwankwaso.
## What happened

During a visit to Kano State, reported on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, Blord was seen wearing a cap with the words 'Nigeria Must Be OK', a slogan associated with Kwankwaso, the NDC's vice-presidential candidate on Peter Obi's ticket. Many social media users took it as a possible sign of support for the Obi–Kwankwaso campaign.
## 'Nigeria Must Be OK' caption

Blord later shared a photo of himself in the cap with a caption praising Kano and ending with the phrase 'Nigeria Must Be OK', associated with the Obi–Kwankwaso campaign, further fuelling speculation that he has shifted his support from Sowore, who is running for president on a different platform.
## Background

The appearance drew attention because Blord had earlier declared support for activist Omoyele Sowore after Sowore was released from Kuje Prison in April 2026. At the time, Blord praised Sowore for intervening in his own legal case, described himself as a member of the Revolution Now movement and was presented with a branded beret. Blord has not publicly announced any change in his political allegiance.
more: Blord wore a 'Nigeria Must Be OK' cap in Kano.
He earlier backed Sowore's movement.

stories.h: "Nigerians, please stop attacking my mum": Son of second wife accused of mistreating Mrs Anulika in Ukehe speaks out
stories.p: The son of the second wife accused of mistreating Mrs Gertrude Anulika Ngwu at her husband's Ozo ceremony in Ukehe, Enugu State, has begged Nigerians to stop attacking his mother online, saying she does not deserve the hate.
body: The son of the second wife at the centre of the viral Ukehe controversy has spoken out, begging Nigerians to stop attacking his mother.
## "Is it not enough already?"
"Nigerians, please stop attacking my mum. Is it not enough already? That woman does not deserve all this hate," he said.
"Do you want her to die? If anything happens to my mum, you people won't like it. Please, this is enough."
## How it started

His mother has faced a wave of criticism online since a video from his father's Ozo title-taking ceremony went viral. In the video, the second wife's children reportedly refused to spray money on the first wife, Mrs Gertrude Anulika Ngwu, despite repeated appeals from the master of ceremonies.
Claims then spread online that Mrs Anulika had endured years of mockery over being childless and had moved back to her father's home. Those claims have not been independently verified.
Since then, well-wishers have visited Mrs Anulika with gifts and money, and the Enugu governor's wife sent a representative with cash and promises of a house and a business.
## The other side of the story
The son's plea is a reminder that there are always two sides to a family story, and that online anger can quickly turn into harassment.

Sympathy for Mrs Anulika is understandable. But insults and threats against another woman, whose side of the story has not been heard, help no one. Families caught up in viral moments are still real people.
## Over to you
Has the online reaction to the Ukehe video gone too far? Can Nigerians support Mrs Anulika without attacking the other family?
more: The second wife's son says his mother is being attacked online.
He asked Nigerians to stop the hate.
The claims against his mother have not been verified.

stories.h: Jigawa declares holiday as Tinubu visits for rally and project launches
stories.p: Jigawa State declared Tuesday a public holiday for President Tinubu's first official visit since 2023. He is due to hold an APC rally and commission projects including an agricultural mechanisation programme with 400 tractors.
body: Jigawa State has declared Tuesday, 10 November 2026, a public holiday for a visit by President Bola Tinubu.
## The visit

Governor Umar Namadi told journalists in Dutse on Monday that the President would hold an All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rally and inaugurate four projects. He said it would be Tinubu's first official visit to the state since he took office in May 2023. The projects include a technical services centre, a skills acquisition centre named after the President, an agricultural mechanisation programme and a dualised road in Dutse.
## The farm equipment
The agricultural package includes 400 tractors, 60 combine harvesters, 150 boom sprayers and 150 seeders, along with other equipment intended to boost farm output in the state.
## Power pledge at the rally

At the APC rally in Jigawa, Tinubu promised to lower the cost of living and provide reliable electricity, saying the old privatisation model was not working. During his 2023 campaign he said Nigerians should not re-elect him if he failed to provide stable power in his first term.
## Background

The Jigawa visit continues the President's campaign tour, which in the past week has taken him to Akwa Ibom, Rivers and Ebonyi states. Namadi, elected on the APC platform in 2023, is a strong supporter of the President's re-election. The North-West, which includes Jigawa, has one of the largest voting populations in Nigeria.
more: Tuesday is a public holiday in Jigawa.
Tinubu will commission four projects.

stories.h: 2027 Senate presidency: Orji Uzor Kalu says he cannot reject Tinubu's choice as political battle begins
stories.p: Senator Orji Uzor Kalu says he would accept the Senate presidency if President Tinubu backed him, adding his name to talk of the post going to the South-East after 2027, where Imo Governor Hope Uzodimma has also been linked to it.
body: Senator Orji Uzor Kalu has openly said he would be willing to become Nigeria's next Senate President, and would have no reason to turn down the position if President Bola Ahmed Tinubu backed him for it.
## "I can't say no"

The former Abia State governor, who represents Abia North Senatorial District, made the statement in a television interview, as talk about the leadership of the next National Assembly begins to gather pace ahead of the 2027 general elections.
"If Tinubu chooses me as the next Senate President, I can't say no," Kalu said.
Brief as it was, the statement has added another twist to the political calculations already taking shape within the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC).
## Zoning to the South-East?

For some time, there has been talk of zoning the next Senate presidency to the South-East. Nothing has been officially agreed, but that has not stopped political figures from being linked to the position.

One of the names being mentioned is Imo State Governor Hope Uzodimma, who served as senator for Imo West before becoming governor. His reported interest has sparked political conversation, given his influence within the APC and his relationship with the party's national leadership.
There have also been reports of reactions involving FCT Minister Nyesom Wike, although the extent of any disagreement over the position remains unclear.
## Kalu versus Uzodimma
Both Kalu and Uzodimma are experienced politicians from the South-East. Both have served in the Senate, and both have strong relationships within the ruling party.

The big question is whether the APC will actually zone the Senate presidency to the South-East in 2027, and if so, who will win the party's backing. For now, there is no official confirmation that the position has been reserved for the region.
## The senators decide
It is worth remembering that the President has no constitutional power to appoint the Senate President. Senators elect their presiding officer themselves when a new National Assembly is inaugurated.
Even so, presidential support and internal party negotiations often play a major role in deciding who eventually emerges.

Whether Kalu's remarks signal serious ambition or simply a willingness to serve if called upon remains to be seen. What is clear is that the race for the leadership of the next National Assembly is already attracting attention, even before Nigerians go to the polls.
## Over to you
If the Senate presidency is zoned to the South-East, who would be the better choice: Orji Uzor Kalu or Hope Uzodimma?
more: Kalu says he would accept the Senate presidency if Tinubu backed him.
Hope Uzodimma has also been linked to the position.
Senators, not the President, elect the Senate President.

stories.h: "My hair costs more than my clothes": Davido's elder sister, Sharon Adeleke, says she doesn't believe in spending big on outfits
stories.p: Davido's elder sister, Sharon Adeleke, says she would rather spend good money on her hair than on expensive designer clothes. She also revealed that her own wedding dress cost just $2,000, and that her outfit for Davido and Chioma's white wedding was a last-minute rescue.
body: Davido's elder sister, Sharon Adeleke, has opened up about her fashion choices, revealing that she would rather spend good money on her hair than buy expensive designer clothes.
## "My hair costs more than my clothes"
Speaking on a podcast, Sharon said she has never really believed in spending a fortune on clothing, no matter how much money a person has.
She enjoys looking good, especially when it comes to her hair, but she does not see the need to attach an expensive price tag to every outfit.
## The wedding outfit drama
Sharon also spoke about her appearance at Davido and Chioma's white wedding, revealing that things did not go as smoothly as she had planned.

She said she had hired a stylist and a fashion designer to handle her outfit, but they failed to deliver as expected. Everything ended up as a last-minute arrangement, leaving her with little choice but to hope it worked out. At some point, she said, it was simply a case of "God abeg!"
## A $2,000 wedding dress
She also shared an interesting detail about her own wedding. Despite coming from one of Nigeria's wealthiest and best-known families, she said her husband spent just $2,000 on her wedding dress.
She added that she personally paid for the dresses worn by all 13 of her bridesmaids.
## Not what people expect
Her revelations are interesting because many people assume wealthy families spend outrageous amounts on everything they wear.
Now imagine Davido's own elder sister saying she doesn't believe in buying expensive clothes, while some people borrow money just to wear designer labels and impress strangers.
## Over to you
Do you agree with Sharon that expensive clothes are unnecessary, even when you can comfortably afford them?

stories.h: Woman confronts herder after cattle destroy her farm crops in Nasarawa State
stories.p: A woman in Nasarawa State has confronted a herder after his cattle strayed onto her farmland and destroyed crops she had spent months growing. The incident has reopened the question of who pays when a farmer's livelihood is wiped out.
body: A woman in Nasarawa State has confronted a herder after his cattle entered her farmland and destroyed crops she had spent months cultivating.
## Months of work gone
For someone who depends on farming to survive, watching cattle destroy months of hard work can be heartbreaking.

Imagine spending your money on seeds, preparing the land, planting and waiting patiently for harvest, only to wake up one day and find your crops destroyed. Worse still, many farmers borrow money to cultivate their land, hoping to repay the loan after harvest.
## An old source of tension
Incidents like this remain one of the main causes of tension between farmers and herders in parts of Nigeria, and some have escalated into violence in the past.
The question is: who compensates the woman for her losses? Who takes responsibility for the destroyed crops?
## Protection for everyone
Farmers deserve protection, just as herders have a right to carry out their lawful activities. But nobody should be allowed to destroy another person's livelihood without consequences.
Clear rules on grazing, quick ways to settle disputes and fair compensation could help prevent confrontations like this from turning into something worse.
## Over to you
If cattle destroy a farmer's crops, should the owner be made to pay full compensation?
more: The woman confronted a herder over destroyed crops.
The incident happened in Nasarawa State.
Who should pay for the farmer's losses?

stories.h: Victor Umeh: Any Igbo person against Peter Obi is an enemy of the Igbo
stories.p: Senator Victor Umeh of the NDC has said any Igbo person who campaigns against Peter Obi's presidential bid is an enemy of the Igbo people, and urged the South-East to unite behind him. He also cautioned the Anambra government.
body: Senator Victor Umeh, who represents Anambra Central, has warned that any Igbo person working against Peter Obi's presidential ambition is an enemy of the Igbo people.
## What he said

In a video that circulated on Monday, 9 November 2026, Umeh, a member of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), described Obi as the conscience of the Igbo people in the 2027 election and urged South-East residents to unite behind his bid. He cautioned political leaders in the region, particularly the Anambra State Government, against actions that could undermine Obi's campaign.
## Background

Obi, a former Anambra governor, is the NDC's presidential candidate, with Rabiu Kwankwaso as his running mate. While he remains popular in the South-East, several of the region's governors have declared support for President Bola Tinubu. Anambra Governor Charles Soludo's APGA last week adopted Tinubu as its candidate and promised him half of the state's votes, while Ebonyi Governor Francis Nwifuru on Monday promised Tinubu 80 per cent of Ebonyi's votes. The NDC in Anambra has set a target of 98 per cent of the state's votes for Obi.
## Reactions
The Anambra government had not publicly responded at the time of writing.
## Yul Edochie responds

Actor Yul Edochie, a supporter of President Tinubu, challenged Umeh in a video on 10 November, saying he respected the senator but that such remarks could make Igbo people see one another as enemies. He said political choice is a personal right, and noted that Tinubu and Seyi Makinde are both from the South-West, yet no Yoruba leader has called supporters of either man enemies of the region.
## What happens next
The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
more: Umeh says Obi is the conscience of the Igbo.
He cautioned the Anambra government.
Several South-East governors back Tinubu.

stories.h: INEC warns against 'Rig and Die' slogan ahead of 2027 elections, raises concerns over electoral violence
stories.p: INEC has raised serious concern over the growing use of the "Rig and Die" slogan by some political actors ahead of the 2027 elections, warning that such language could encourage violence. But the slogan also points to a deeper problem: Nigerians' fear that their votes will not count.
body: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has expressed serious concern over the growing use of the controversial "Rig and Die" slogan by some political actors ahead of Nigeria's 2027 general elections.
## A dangerous slogan
According to the electoral body, such language is dangerous and could encourage political violence, putting innocent Nigerians at risk as the country prepares for another major election.
## Why it has come to this
The controversy also raises a question that cannot be ignored: why has Nigeria's electoral system reached a point where political actors feel the need to use such threatening language?

For years, Nigerians have complained about electoral malpractice, vote buying, intimidation, ballot box snatching and alleged manipulation of results. Many voters have grown frustrated, especially when they believe their votes do not count.
With the 2027 elections approaching, political tensions are already building.
## Confidence in the process
INEC is right to warn against inflammatory statements that could endanger lives. But the commission must also recognise that public confidence in the electoral process remains a major concern.
Nigerians want elections where votes are counted honestly, results are transmitted transparently, and those caught manipulating the process face real consequences.
Political leaders, too, have a responsibility to avoid statements that could turn ordinary citizens into victims of electoral violence.
No election should cost an innocent Nigerian their life. At the same time, electoral offenders must never be allowed to operate without consequences.
## Over to you
Should INEC be more concerned about the slogan "Rig and Die", or about fixing the electoral weaknesses that make Nigerians fear rigging in the first place?
more: INEC warns the 'Rig and Die' slogan could fuel violence.
Many Nigerians fear their votes will not count.
Electoral offenders must face real consequences.

stories.h: Beautiful moment as former Aviation Minister Osita Chidoka celebrates his father's 100th birthday with family
stories.p: Former Aviation Minister Osita Chidoka's father has reached the remarkable age of 100, with family members coming together to celebrate his birthday and the gift of long life.
body: Reaching 100 years of age is no small blessing, and for the family of former Aviation Minister Osita Chidoka, it is a moment truly worth celebrating.
## A century of life
The former minister's father has reached the remarkable age of 100, and family members have come together to celebrate his birthday and the gift of long life.

Photos from the celebration show the centenarian seated on an ornate chair in flowing white traditional attire, with coral beads around his neck, a red cap resting on his lap and a walking stick in hand.

Just imagine living for an entire century. The things he must have witnessed, the changes Nigeria has gone through, the generations he has watched grow, and the countless memories gathered along the way.
## A special blessing
For his children, grandchildren and other loved ones, having their father around at 100 is something truly special. Many families would give anything for such an opportunity.
Happy 100th birthday to Papa Chidoka! May his remaining years be filled with peace, good health and happiness.
## Over to you
Are you fortunate enough to have a parent or grandparent who has reached 90 or even 100 years? Share your story.
more: Osita Chidoka's father has turned 100.
The family gathered to celebrate the milestone.
Chidoka is a former Minister of Aviation.

stories.h: All is fair in war, but has VeryDarkMan gone too far with Davido?
stories.p: Amid his ongoing disagreement with Davido, VeryDarkMan has reportedly brought up the deaths of the singer's late friends, a painful chapter long surrounded by unproven rumours. Criticism is fair, but should personal tragedy ever be used as ammunition?
body: VeryDarkMan (VDM) does not seem to believe in fighting fairly. When he has a disagreement with someone, he appears willing to go to any length to make his point, even if it means bringing up some of the most painful moments in that person's life.
## A painful chapter
Over the years, Davido has lost several close friends and associates in tragic circumstances. Their deaths set off all kinds of rumours and conspiracy theories online.

Some people even claimed the deaths were connected to rituals or sacrifices for fame and success. None of those claims was ever proven, and there is no credible evidence linking Davido to any of their deaths.

Imagine losing people who were very close to you, only to have strangers turn their deaths into accusations against you. Davido has lived with those memories for years. He has carried on with his music career, built his family and moved forward with his life, but moving forward does not mean the pain has disappeared.
## Reopening old wounds
Now, amid his ongoing disagreement with Davido, VDM has reportedly brought those painful memories back into public discussion. This is where things appear to be getting out of hand.

You can criticise Davido's music, lifestyle, public statements or behaviour. You can disagree with him and challenge his opinions. That is perfectly normal. But bringing up the deaths of his close friends because of a disagreement raises serious questions.
What exactly is the intention? Is it to expose wrongdoing, to make a legitimate point, or simply to hurt someone where he is most vulnerable?
## Where are the limits?

VDM has built a reputation for confronting people without holding back, and his supporters may argue he is only giving his opponents the same treatment they give others. But surely there should be limits.

Davido is not above criticism, and neither is VeryDarkMan. Both are public figures who should be held accountable for their actions. Using someone's personal tragedies as ammunition in a public quarrel, however, is something else entirely.

There are some experiences people never fully recover from. They may laugh and smile in public, but that does not mean they have forgotten. If winning an argument requires reopening another person's deepest wounds, perhaps the argument has already gone too far.
## Over to you

People say all is fair in love and war, but does that mean we should abandon all compassion when we disagree with someone? Has VDM crossed the line with Davido, or is this just two public figures fighting without limits?
more: VDM has reportedly raised the deaths of Davido's late friends.
Rumours about those deaths were never proven.
Is personal tragedy fair game in a public feud?

stories.h: Wike promises ₦10m to each councillor whose ward delivers votes for Tinubu
stories.p: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly promised ₦10 million to every councillor across Nigeria whose ward votes for President Tinubu in the 2027 election, speaking at an event in Kwali Area Council.
body: FCT Minister Nyesom Wike has reportedly promised a ₦10 million reward to each councillor in Nigeria whose ward votes for President Bola Tinubu in the 2027 presidential election.
## What he said

Wike made the pledge during a political engagement in Kwali Area Council of the Federal Capital Territory, according to reports on Monday, 9 November 2026. He also praised his Rainbow Coalition, saying it was bringing together politicians from across the country, and urged residents of Kwali and the wider FCT to back the President's re-election, arguing that a second term would bring more development to Abuja.
## Background

Wike, a former Rivers governor and PDP chieftain, leads the Rainbow Coalition of politicians from the PDP and other parties backing Tinubu. He has been one of the President's most vocal campaigners, frequently criticising opposition candidates Peter Obi and Atiku Abubakar.
## Why it matters
INEC this week also warned political actors against inflammatory rhetoric ahead of the elections.
## What happens next
The presidential election is scheduled for 16 January 2027.
